about: src/lib/tax_vectors.json is a byte-for-byte copy of madar-shared's file at this tag (madar-money tax::compute, which the backend prices every bill with; features/public-ordering/bill.test.ts runs the storefront's checkout bill against it). A change is made there, released with a tag, and copied here with the tag and hash below updated; scripts/check-shared-vectors.sh (CI) and shared_vectors.test.ts check it.
